correctness.rationale: For every n and selected sharp-peak-start coordinate set S, forcing disjoint adjacent UD pairs and deleting them establishes exact inclusion-exclusion. The first-return decomposition proves the all-marked series and nonnegative recurrence (with small bases). Deletion of one marked position gives 2 times a length n-2 multiplier; simultaneous induction proves all spatial sign sums are >= the all-marked sum, strictly so for n>=6. The latter is positive for all n>=4. Walsh diagonalization gives sharp condition and inverse norms, and square-root singularity transfer gives the exact asymptotic prefactor. All 4094 characters in n=2..12 were checked by three independently structured exact integer methods in the delivered checker.
